package.description: A modern, high-performance GUI for the scrcpy

en-US.author: KB @ kilObit
en-US.description: A modern, high-performance GUI for the scrcpy
en-US.longDescription: ScrcpyGUI v4 is a modern, feature-rich GUI for scrcpy, completely rebuilt from the ground up using Tauri v2, React 19, and Rust. It transforms your Android device into a professional tool for gaming, development, and content creation.
en-US.name: ScrcpyGUI
en-US.releaseNotes:
This update brings full compatibility with scrcpy v4.1, adding new codec options, encoder flexibility, and under-the-hood stability improvements.
✨ Highlights & New Features
VP8 & VP9 Video Codecs Support:
Added VP8 and VP9 to the video codec selection in both Screen Mirroring and Camera modes.
Great fallback for devices that do not support H.264, H.265, or AV1 hardware encoding.
Ignore Video Encoder Constraints (--ignore-video-encoder-constraints):
Added a dedicated toggle in Performance settings to bypass video encoder size constraints.
Useful for devices that report inaccurate encoder limits causing mirroring startup errors or resolution mismatches.
scrcpy v4.1 Core Engine Integration:
Compatible with scrcpy v4.1 automatic downloads and updates.
Benefits from upstream improvements including dynamic terminal titles, automated media scan after file pushes, updated dependencies (FFmpeg 8.1.2, SDL 3.4.12), and camera size fixes.
